review_notes: I read the whole target file and its sibling, SchemeProperties/DenseOpenRationalCategory.lean. The sibling is the non-Over analogue and has the same simp pattern. This file's simp set is small and well-oriented. It has projection lemmas for `of` and `hom`, `toRationalMap_id` and `toRationalMap_comp` for the category, and `forget_obj_toScheme` and `forget_map_toRationalMap` for the functor. All are proved by `rfl`, and each rewrites a projection of a constructor or structure into its underlying data, so I see no cycle or competing rule. `toRationalMap_comp` unfolds composition into `compOfPullsDenseOpens`, which is the canonical normal form that the sibling file also uses. `isOver_hom` is proof-irrelevant and `isOver_iff_compHom` is a genuine iff, so leaving both without `@[simp]` is reasonable. I did not run Lean. One residual doubt: `toBase_of` has a left side typed `(of p).toScheme ⟶ S` and a right side typed `X ⟶ S`. I have no evidence that this causes a problem, so I did not report it. I found no justified simp-interface defect.
